title: Verisk CargoNet 2026 第三季貨物竊盜分析
value: Q3 估計損失 2.301 億美元；平均被竊價值約增 72%
summary: 2026 年第三季美國與加拿大供應鏈犯罪 547 件，年減 33%、季減 19%；該季估計損失 2.301 億美元，較去年同期 2.051 億美元增 12%。截至 9 月累計損失 7.189 億美元，年增 39%，件數由 2,755 降至 2,072（年減 25%）；有記載價值者的平均被竊價值約增 72%（261,115 美元至 448,456 美元）。虛構提貨 138 件，占比約 25%（前為 18%）。第三季 100 萬美元以上竊案 19 件，去年同期 9 件，其中多起涉及高價值電子產品與資料中心物料。加州、伊利諾州、紐澤西州與德州合計占該季件數 57%。

en.title: Verisk CargoNet Q3 2026 cargo theft analysis
en.value: Q3 estimated losses of US$230.1 million; average stolen value up about 72%
en.summary: In Q3 2026, Verisk CargoNet recorded 547 supply chain crime incidents in the United States and Canada, down 33% year over year and 19% from the prior quarter. Estimated losses for the quarter were US$230.1 million, up 12% from US$205.1 million. Year-to-date losses through September were US$718.9 million, up 39%, while incidents fell 25% from 2,755 to 2,072. The average value of stolen goods, among incidents with a documented value, rose about 72%, from US$261,115 to US$448,456. Fictitious pickups were 138 incidents, about 25% of reported activity, up from 18%. There were 19 thefts of US$1 million or more in Q3, compared with 9 a year earlier, many involving high-value electronics and data center materials. California, Illinois, New Jersey and Texas accounted for 57% of incidents.

title: Chaucer 與 Indemni 推出鎖定策略性竊盜的美國貨物保險方案
value: 單一運輸限額最高 1,500 萬美元
summary: Chaucer（Lloyd's 1084 辛迪加）主導，新核准的承保代理人 Indemni（科技導向的貨物風險專業機構）代為承保，鎖定策略性竊盜，亦即罪犯偽冒合法承運人提貨的虛構提貨。方案保障美國陸運，含單一運輸每批最高 1,500 萬美元、年度或有貨物責任限額最高 100 萬美元及獨立策略性竊盜保險，並由 Aviva、Atrium、Blenheim 與 Talbot 辛迪加提供額外承保能量；風險控管包括核對實際提貨駕駛、安全放行運費確認、貨況追蹤、文件查核、照片證據與可供理賠的稽核軌跡，每批逾 18 項自動查核。Indemni 稱 AI 基礎設施建置使單一拖車所載晶片、伺服器與資料中心設備價值可達 1,500 萬美元，此為該公司自行提出的數字。

en.title: Chaucer and Indemni launch a US cargo insurance proposition targeting strategic theft
en.value: Single transit limit of up to US$15 million
en.summary: Chaucer (Syndicate 1084 at Lloyd's) leads, and Indemni, a cargo risk specialist focused on technology and newly approved as a Lloyd's coverholder, underwrites on Chaucer's behalf. The proposition targets strategic theft, that is, fraud in which criminals impersonate legitimate carriers to collect loads (fictitious pickups). It covers US land transit, including single transit cover of up to US$15 million per shipment, annual contingent cargo with liability limits of up to US$1 million, and standalone strategic theft cover, with additional capacity from the Aviva, Atrium, Blenheim and Talbot syndicates. Risk controls include verifying the driver who physically collects the load, secure release of the rate confirmation, shipment tracking, document checks, photo evidence and an audit trail usable for claims, with more than 18 automated checks per shipment. Indemni says that as AI infrastructure is built out, a single trailer load of chips, servers and data center hardware can be worth up to US$15 million, a figure given by the company itself.

en.value: 125 incidents, direct losses of more than US$4.8 million

Theft from facilities accounted for more than 57%, violent methods overtook intrusive methods for the first time in June, and the report points to cyber-enabled fraud such as phishing, GPS spoofing and carrier impersonation.

en.summary: Of data center related claims of about EUR 700 million (about US$800 million), fire accounts for more than half of severity; water damage is the most common, followed by deliberate acts (including crime and cyber incidents). The global data center insurance market is projected to double from about US$11 billion.
